resources.string: Phones of the group share their positions over Bluetooth during the outing, within a few dozen metres (less with the phone in a pocket). Each one passes on the last positions it heard. You see each member\'s last known position and its age. No account, no server, no network. Not an avalanche transceiver: it finds no one under the snow.
Create and show the QR code
The group shares the plan of the day validated on this phone.
No plan of the day validated: members are compared by distance only.

Let the others scan this code before leaving.
Bluetooth is off or not permitted: positions are neither sent nor received.
